coverage_assessment: Botswana — November 2020 bounded open-web report. Search cutoff is 2026-10-07; actual work on 2026-10-11 is disclosed as post-cutoff. Two multi-query search actions returned 32 and 38 result headers. They covered English, Setswana/Ngwanaitseele, early/late month windows, regional cities, workers/students/women/pensioners, police responses and selected local outlets. A Nov 18 Patriot item about truck drivers was opened: it reports individual complaints about COVID checks, escorts, waiting and rest, with no assembled crowd or participant count. A separate Nov 14 Windhoek lead describes Namibia residents protesting Botswana BDF killings outside Botswana; it was not opened because search metadata places it outside the assigned territory and against a foreign government, and is recorded as a scope exclusion only. Other surfaced planned civil-service demonstrations were dated January 2021 and not counted. Zero verified in-country candidates were identified in this bounded method; this does not imply that none occurred. English and Setswana discovery was attempted; regional/sector coverage remains incomplete. Open web only; baseline and scientific review pending.
